title: 50 Hour Yin Yoga Teacher Training Course in Uluwatu Bali
metaTitle: 50 Hour Yin Yoga Teacher Training in Uluwatu Bali
metaDescription: Become a Yoga Alliance certified Yin yoga teacher with our comprehensive 50 Hour Yin Yoga Teacher Training Course in Uluwatu Bali.
summary: This short course is ideal for busy souls or yoga lovers who want to learn Yin Yoga’s relaxing, slow-paced style.
intro: Uluwatu in Bali—with its quiet beaches, golden sunsets, and peaceful energy—is the perfect place for our 50 Hour Yin Yoga Teacher Training. This short, sweet course is ideal for busy souls or yoga lovers who want to learn Yin Yoga’s relaxing, slow-paced style. Practice gentle poses (held for 3-5 minutes) to ease stress, loosen tight hips/back, and recharge your body and mind.

In Uluwatu’s serene vibe, you’ll learn how to use props like cushions and blocks to make poses comfy and safe. Discover the basics of Yin Yoga philosophy, simple anatomy tips, and how to guide soothing sessions. Finish with a certificate and the skills to share Yin Yoga’s healing power—or just deepen your own practice.
Perfect for a mindful break, this training mixes learning with time to unwind and enjoy Bali’s beauty.

dining.text: Every meal is freshly prepared using wholesome plant-based ingredients with the highest standards of hygiene, cleanliness, and mindfulness. Our sattvic cuisine supports your yoga practice by nourishing the body, calming the mind, and promoting inner balance throughout your training.
mealTimes: Lunch & Dinner are not served on Sundays.

arrival: In order for you to rest properly before the opening ceremony on the 1st day of the course, the check-in to the school should be one day before the course begins. Your check-in time must be between 10 AM to 4 PM. We provide you a complimentary stay for that night. Your check-out on the last day of the course must be between 12 PM to 2 PM.
prerequisites: Our 50-Hour Yin Yoga Course is suitable for all levels, including beginners, intermediate practitioners, and advanced students.

policies.title: Important Points
items: We cover only the course syllabus that is specifically mentioned on the course page.

policies.title: Booking
items: Advance booking fee: In order to book the course, you are required to deposit the booking fee. We accept the booking fee via Razorpay | Western Union | bank transfer or TransferWise. An official booking confirmation letter will be sent to you shortly after successful advance deposit; the balance of the course fees can be paid on arrival at school either by credit card, debit card or cash.

policies.title: Terms & Conditions
items: Discipline Rules for Students – Smoking and alcohol are strictly prohibited in the school.

Refund Policy – The Advanced Course Fees, Complete Course Fee, Retreat Fee, Visa Fee or Any Other Payment will not be refundable in any case. Only in the case of emergency students can join the Yin Yoga Teacher Training in Bali on other schedules. If a student cancels the course after joining it, we accept cancellation but course fees will not be refunded in cancellation.
